📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

8. Energy Trend?
Oil strength contrasts with natural-gas weakness: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.52% | 1M: +8.34%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.24% | 1M: +14.17%). UNG is BELOW TREND (1W: -10.82% | 1M: -9.02%).

🧭 STRATEGY

No major 1W/1M divergence across the core ETFs; IWM’s RECOVERY (1W: +0.58% | 1M: -1.86%) is a short-term countertrend bounce.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Stay selective in this NEUTRAL regime: favor defensive exposure represented by XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.88% | 1M: +8.46%), while reducing exposure to XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -3.62% | 1M: -6.66%). TLT remains ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.21% | 1M: +2.00%), while broad sector breadth argues against treating the tape as uniformly risk-off.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

BEARISH: If technology weakness persists, reduce exposure to XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -3.62% | 1M: -6.66%).

BEARISH: If industrial metals remain weak, monitor CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -2.48% | 1M: -5.27%) for further downside confirmation.

13. Key Levels?
No absolute price or ratio levels were supplied; monitor SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.01% | 1M: -0.50%) and XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -3.62% | 1M: -6.66%) for stabilization. Also watch whether VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.20% | 1M: +5.66%) and the falling HYG/LQD ratio signal easing or continued stress.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive, a broad-strength backdrop offset by defensive risk signals. XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.88% | 1M: +8.46%) and XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.52% | 1M: +8.34%) show relative strength, with Value ahead of Growth. Monitor rising fear in VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.20% | 1M: +5.66%) and continued weakness in XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -3.62% | 1M: -6.66%).
